_comment: P2-8 ExLlamaV3 bodies EN（2026-11-03）。sections 与源侧固定小节对齐；sources 按索引对齐 frontmatter。

axes.model_access: Uses EXL3 quantised checkpoints (.exl3) and some HF safetensors; supported models follow the official repository and docs and are not enumerated here. It is the successor line to ExLlamaV2.
axes.runtime: A CUDA inference engine for local/single-machine multi-GPU use; the PyPI package is exllamav3 (1.6.5, released 2026-10-25). A CUDA environment is required; exact versions follow the official repo.
axes.local_files: Self-hosted, with weights and .exl3 checkpoints on the local machine; there is no official hosted cloud.
axes.background: A local inference process, not a long-running service; serving usually goes through an outer layer such as TabbyAPI.
axes.tools: Primarily inference execution; tool calling and MCP are not core and are not verified item by item.
axes.context: Long context depends on VRAM and configuration; KV-cache details live in official docs and are not verified item by item.
axes.permissions: A local process with no account system; permissions come from the runtime environment.
axes.fit: Fits NVIDIA single/multi-GPU users chasing EXL3 quantisation and low-latency inference who are willing to set up CUDA. Does not fit AMD/CPU, an out-of-the-box GUI, or the GGUF ecosystem.

runs: This site has not completed throughput or VRAM tests; the conclusions cover runtime capability and licensing only.
unknowns:
- Current supported model-architecture list (official repo is authoritative; not enumerated here)
- CUDA requirements and VRAM floors per release
- Compatibility matrix with TabbyAPI
related: The outer API server for ExLlama; the two are commonly used together.
The GGUF route, contrasting with the EXL3/CUDA route.
